facts.fact: MISAU's SIS-MA page describes an interoperability platform, a mediating layer centralising communication between SIS-MA and other systems, with live integrations to the medicines-logistics system of CMAM (Ferramenta Central) and to the Ministry of Justice's SIRCEV for death-certificate data.

systems.platform: DHIS2-based SIS-MA with intermediary API and Master Facility List
systems.owner: Ministry of Health (MISAU), Departamento de Informação para Saúde
Central de Medicamentos e Artigos Médicos (CMAM)

note: as_of is the page's published date (a retrieved-date proxy); the page gives no date for when the platform entered service, and no counts or transaction figures.
